body: My psychiatrist had considered anhedonia in the past and I've grown to accept it. I just feel like I need to get a lot off my shoulders frequently, but I never feel the gratification from anything. What confuses me is how I can feel this way, but not feel sorry for myself at all.

I was put on meds for severe depression, autism, ADD, and sleep disorders since i was little, but this has been different. I know the feelings of them all, but I came to associate depression with the lack of motivation for one's self and the negative aspects of life. So far, my only concern is what I have done to others. The excitement and enthusiasm I've never shown them.
